name: OceanGym
summary: 用于水下具身智能体感知、连续控制导航和决策的高保真海洋仿真环境与数据集。
summaryEn: A high-fidelity underwater simulation environment and dataset for perception, continuous-control navigation, and embodied decision-making.
scale: Eight underwater tasks with released perception data and evaluation trajectories
scaleZh: 八项水下任务，并发布感知数据和评测轨迹
access: Environment data and trajectories available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 环境数据和轨迹已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 可调环境参数并生成连续水下交互轨迹的仿真基准
verdictEn: A configurable simulator capable of generating continuous underwater interaction trajectories
wmNote: 水下动力学和连续动作空间扩展了陆地机器人之外的世界模型场景。
wmNoteEn: Underwater dynamics and continuous actions extend world-model research beyond terrestrial robotics.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2509.26536] OceanGym: A Benchmark Environment for Underwater Embodied Agents
evidence.statement: Underwater tasks expose optical/sonar observations and sequential exploration/interaction in simulated currents; retain as environment benchmark.
